description: This file defines a SubmissionService class responsible for managing data product submissions, including creating submissions, ensuring minimal test submissions, updating states, and retrieving submissions. It interacts with a database and other services like AuditService and DraftService.

classes.name: SubmissionService
classes.description: Service class for managing submission lifecycle, including creation, state updates, and retrieval.

methods.name: ensure_minimal_submission_for_tests
methods.description: Creates minimal test submissions and drafts for deterministic testing, only for specific allowlisted IDs.

methods.name: create_submission
methods.description: Creates a new submission from a draft, queues validation, and records audit events.

methods.name: get_submission
methods.description: Retrieves a submission by its ID.

methods.name: update_state
methods.description: Updates the state of a submission and logs the change via audit events.
